transcript.answer: Lore's own Floor engine (apps/floor) was deleted on 2026-10-02 (PR #2431, specs/external-floor FR16). The PR removed about 17,500 lines and 113 test files, plus the floor-helm subchart, its build workflow and the five ticks only it answered. Migration 0095 also removed its bus subscription. It was replaced by the rewritten external Floor, a standalone engine at re-cinq/floor that runs in the same cluster. Lore now reaches it only through @re-cinq/floor-client, as set out in ADR-049. The move was made one family of assembly lines at a time. The code-review lines now run there as floor pipeline YAML files.
